title: Wave class
description:
The simplified spin-momentum wave class of the altermagnetic order.

The vocabulary is taken from the WaveClassSimple column of the symmetry-summary tables: `s`, `d`, and `g` denote the corresponding anisotropy of the spin-split Fermi surface, and `d/g` denotes a class that is ambiguous between `d` and `g`.
A null value means no linked symmetry entry provides a wave class for this material.
